resume: Scientists studying galaxy cluster MS0735.6+7421, about 2.6 billion light-years away in Camelopardalis, saw a huge black hole growing fast even though it should have stopped. Two vast cavities extended from the black hole, suggesting the biggest explosion since the Big Bang.
